title: A query returns every current claim it is entitled to, stops returning the superseded version, and does not cross a user boundary
notes: The queries are declared here rather than written by the runner so recall is reproducible from this file. Relevance carries a stated reason: the deploy window moved from 02:00 to 03:00, so the 03:00 claim is gold and the 02:00 claim must stop being current after the supersession. Evidence is a record-style sentence so the claim is entailed by its span under the production verifier as well as the lexical stand-in. Query text names the full predicate token because the full-text projection keys a claim on its subject, predicate and object — 'deploy.window' is one token, so a query that only says 'deploy window' matches no claim at all.
